About Us

A dependable wholesale partner for shops, retailers and traders.

Oswal Wholesale is a wholesale supplier dealing in a wide range of FMCG, kirana, grocery and everyday shop-use products. We serve shopkeepers, retailers and traders who need dependable supply and honest wholesale rates.

Our approach is simple: keep the range wide, the rates competitive and the dealing straightforward — so you can stock your shop with confidence and reorder without hassle.

  • Wide range of products

    FMCG, kirana, grocery and general shop-use items under one roof.

  • Competitive wholesale rates

    Pricing built for resale — so your margins stay healthy.

  • Convenient product discovery

    Browse the catalogue on WhatsApp and enquire in a few taps.

  • Customer-focused service

    A responsive team that answers your questions and helps you choose.

  • Reliable business relationships

    Clear communication and consistent dealing, order after order.
